visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans slowly across a yellow educational board titled in Japanese characters. The board contains several circular display windows showing biological specimens of varying colors (dark green, reddish-brown, yellow) which are various medical samples of infant stools. The board is mounted in a wooden frame. (2) The pan continues sideways and downward, showing more rows of circular containers with specific medical labels printed in Japanese and Traditional Chinese below each one. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating an outdoor or well-lit exhibition environment. (3) A straight cut transitions to a selfie-style shot of a young man. He has longish dark hair, a mustache, and wears a black knit beanie with a green jacket. He holds a clear plastic cup filled with a milk-tea colored iced drink and takes a sip through a white straw while looking directly at the camera with a subtle smirk.
